handoff.section.recent: ## 3 近期对话原文 (Recent Verbatim Turns)
handoff.resume.user_pending: 最后一条是用户提问且无实质回复 → 立即回答并执行该请求 (Last turn is an unanswered user request -> immediately answer and execute it).
handoff.resume.mid_task: 前任在工具调用或未闭合步骤中断 → 从中断处继续完成并验证，切勿重做已完成步骤 (Interrupted mid-task during tool execution -> continue from interruption point and verify).
handoff.resume.awaiting_user: 前任刚提出方案/问题等待用户拍板 → 简短复述待拍板项询问用户，切勿擅自执行未获批操作 (Predecessor proposed a plan/question awaiting user decision -> briefly restate and ask user).
handoff.resume.completed_idle: 上一轮已收口 → 简短确认已接手，等待新指令 (Previous turn completed cleanly -> briefly confirm handoff readiness and wait for new instructions).
